importPage.title: Import
importPage.intro: Bring data in from outside: raw DNA files, documents and blood tests, and measurement timelines. Pick the person first; everything is shown for review before it is saved.
importPage.noPeople: Add a person first, then import their data.
importPage.local: Read on this device; nothing leaves it.
importPage.documentWhat: A photo, scan or PDF of a lab result, letter or prescription, or lab results pasted as text.
importPage.documentWhere: Text and PDFs with selectable text are read on this device; photos and scans go to Google Gemini with your own key, after you confirm.
importPage.csvWhat: A spreadsheet or phone/device export of measurements over time: weight, height, blood pressure, glucose…
